criteria_prompt_block:
CAMPAIGN GLASSMAN-BARD-POWERPORT-001 — Bard PowerPort
Ask one question at a time, in this order:
1. Was a Bard PowerPort or similar port catheter implanted? (qualifying answers: Yes, a Bard PowerPort / Yes, a port, not sure which brand)
2. Roughly when was it implanted? (qualifying answers: n/a)
3. What went wrong? (qualifying answers: Infection or sepsis / Blood clot / The catheter broke, cracked or moved)
4. Did it lead to surgery to remove it, or a hospital stay? (qualifying answers: Yes, removed / Yes, hospitalized)
5. When did the problem happen? (qualifying answers: Within the last 2 years)
6. Is another lawyer already handling this claim? (qualifying answers: No)
Qualifies when: Bard PowerPort or similar implanted port catheter; Infection/sepsis, blood clot, or catheter fracture/migration; Led to removal surgery or a hospital stay; No other lawyer handling the claim
Does not qualify when: No port implanted; No serious complication; Already represented
Delivery: scheduled_callback.
Never say the caller qualifies; say they may potentially qualify for review. Never give legal advice.
